label: FlowCast v1.0 as released

compute.notes: Not trained in the bake-off: the released FlowCast v1.0 weights (models/flowcast). Its own training: r1b ~15 min on one shared core + 12k bank 7-15 min; nowcast fine-tune 2,500 steps.

feature_engineering: FlowCast's own: 11 scaled daily features (P/10, log1p P, PET/5, T/10 x3, SRAD/150, vp/1000, wind/3, sin/cos day of year) + the 18-value static vector (config.STATIC_NAMES); target in units of the basin's mean precipitation. Nowcast adds log1p(5 x qobs/p_mean) lagged by the lead, an availability flag and lead/7.
rule: FlowCast's own ladder (models/flowcast/ratchet.yaml): keep if sim NSE > incumbent + 0.01 AND dev median NSE >= 95 % of the incumbent's.

rungs.why: FlowCast's first rung (record only; not run in the bake-off).

rungs.change: loss scaled by Fu runoff ratio of the forcing

rungs.why: FlowCast v1.0 as released (sim 0.425 on p1, dev 0.425). Copied unchanged as the bake-off's incumbent reference.
